notes.title: v2.18.0 Release Note
notes.content:
Dear Adventurers,

    In order to enhance the game experience, the game will undergo a version update on [i][u]Oct.10, 2024 from 00:30 AM to 04:30 AM (Pacific Daylight Time)[/u][/i]. At the same time, there will be server maintenance, during which you will not be able to log in to the game. After the update, you will enjoy more exciting activities. We apologize for the inconvenience and will be giving you a deluxe gift pack as compensation. Thank you very much for your understanding and patience.

The new content added in this update is as follows:
[list]
[*] New Event: Enigma Maze
    Let's enter the riddle labyrinth together!
[*] New Event: Witches' pranks
    The witch's prank activity is about to start!
[*] New Event: Halloween Banquet
    Halloween is arriving soon and we are going to hold a great banquet. Here we sincerely invite you to join us. There will be many surprises and gifts for everyone. Let's spend a wonderful Halloween night together!
[*] New Season Pass
[*] New Lost Ruins
    The lost ruins are open! There is countless treasure to be discovered!
[*] New Dream Adventure
    The tribe of shamans has encountered some crises, and they take the liberty to ask you to help them go to the deep dream exploration to retrieve some sacrificial materials. The shamans will cast spells to make you enter the dreamland, so what will happen when you enter the dreamland? Come and explore together!
[/list]
